faqData.question: How long does a hair patch last before needing reapplication?
faqData.answer: A hair patch typically lasts 4 to 6 weeks before requiring reapplication. The duration may vary based on factors like adhesion method, care, and lifestyle.

faqData.question: Are hair patches suitable for all types of hair loss patterns?
faqData.answer: Yes, hair patches can be customized to various balding patterns. Consult with a specialist to determine the suitability based on your specific hair loss situation.

faqData.question: Is there discomfort or irritation associated with wearing a hair patch?
faqData.answer: While glue provides a natural hold, it may cause scalp irritation. Tape is gentler but may not last as long. Clips or combs, though easy on and off, can sometimes be felt. Choose the attachment method based on your comfort preferences.

faqData.question: Can I style and treat a hair patch like my natural hair?
faqData.answer: Yes, hair patches can be styled, washed, and treated like natural hair. Follow care instructions provided by the manufacturer or stylist for optimal results.

faqData.question: How affordable are high-quality hair patches compared to surgical hair transplants?
faqData.answer: High-quality hair patches are a more affordable option compared to surgical hair transplants. Hair patches provide a budget-friendly solution to hair loss.

faqData.question: Can I exercise or swim with a hair patch?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can exercise and swim with a hair patch. However, it's advisable to secure it well and follow care guidelines to ensure longevity and maintain its natural appearance.

faqData.question: Are there specific considerations for choosing a hair patch for men's hair loss in India?
faqData.answer: Consider factors like the quality of human hair, color match, design preferences, and attachment method when choosing a hair patch in India. Research and consult with experts to find the most suitable option for your needs.

posts.title: Scalp Micro Pigmentation Safe in India?

faqData.question: Is SMP the same as a regular tattoo?
faqData.answer: No, SMP is not the same as a regular tattoo. It uses different equipment, pigments, and techniques. The pigment is applied more superficially than a traditional tattoo.

faqData.question: How long does SMP last?
faqData.answer: SMP typically lasts for several years, but it can fade over time. Touch-up sessions may be required every few years to maintain the look.

faqData.question: Is the SMP procedure painful?
faqData.answer: Pain levels vary from person to person, but SMP is generally less painful than traditional tattooing. Most clients experience only mild discomfort.

faqData.question: How many sessions are required?
faqData.answer: Typically, SMP requires 2-4 sessions, spaced about a week apart. This can vary based on individual needs and the extent of hair loss.

faqData.question: Can SMP cover scars or birthmarks on the scalp?
faqData.answer: Yes, SMP can be used to camouflage scars, including those from hair transplant surgery, as well as birthmarks.

faqData.question: What should I do for aftercare?
faqData.answer: Aftercare involves keeping the scalp dry for a few days post-treatment, avoiding sun exposure, and not picking or scratching the treated area. Detailed aftercare instructions will be provided by your practitioner.

faqData.question: How soon can I return to work after SMP?
faqData.answer: Most people can return to work the next day. However, the scalp may appear slightly red for a few days following each session.

posts.title: If you sweat a lot, Which base to choose for Hair System?

faqData.question: What's the difference between lace, HD lace and Swiss lace?
faqData.answer: These terms refer to the material used to create the base. Lace base is the most basic and affordable. HD lace and Swiss lace are higher quality, with smaller knots and a more natural appearance. HD lace is a bit thicker, while Swiss lace is the thinnest and most transparent. For heavy sweating, Swiss lace may be the most breathable option.

faqData.question: Which lace base is the most durable?
faqData.answer: HD lace and Swiss lace tend to be more durable than regular lace. The finer, higher quality materials and construction make them more tear-resistant. Proper care and maintenance will also extend the life of any lace base. Be gentle when handling, washing and styling the hair system.

faqData.question: Can I swim or exercise wearing a lace base?
faqData.answer: Any lace base can withstand occasional swimming or exercise. However, frequent or prolonged exposure to water or sweat can damage the lace over time. It's best to limit swimming, hot yoga or other sweat-inducing activities when possible. Always rinse your hair system after and let it air dry completely to prevent damage. Using a hair system specifically designed for activity may be better for an active lifestyle.

faqData.question: How often should I replace my lace base?
faqData.answer: The general rule of thumb is to replace your lace base every 4 to 6 weeks. As the lace ages, it becomes more prone to tearing and looks less natural. Higher quality lace bases like HD lace and Swiss lace may last 6-8 weeks with proper care. If your lace base shows signs of damage or isn't looking natural anymore, it's best to replace it. Your stylist can help determine when it's time for a new base.

faqData.question: Can I style my lace base with heat tools?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can use heat tools like blow dryers, curling irons and flat irons on lace bases. However, use the lowest heat setting and keep the tool moving to avoid damaging the lace. Allow your lace base to cool completely between uses of heat tools. Limit use of extreme heat which can cause the lace to deteriorate faster. With regular heat styling, you may need to replace your lace base more often, around every 3 to 4 weeks.

posts.title: Why Scalp Micropigmentation Goes Wrong?

faqData.question: How painful is the Scalp Micropigmentation procedure?
faqData.answer: Scalp micropigmentation is typically not painful because a local anesthetic is used to numb the area before treatment. You may experience minor discomfort from the needle and sounds of the motorized tattoo pen. The sensation feels like light pinching or pricking. Any discomfort you do feel is temporary and minimal.

faqData.question: How long does Scalp Micropigmentation last?
faqData.answer: Scalp micropigmentation results can last 3 to 5 years before needing a touch up. The pigments will fade over time due to sun exposure and natural fading. To maintain results, most clients need follow up treatments every 1 to 3 years. Proper aftercare and limiting sun exposure will help maximize the results. With regular maintenance, scalp micropigmentation can provide a long-term solution for hair loss.

faqData.question: Will SMP work for my hair loss?
faqData.answer: Scalp micropigmentation can work for many types of hair loss, including:Male pattern baldness: Scalp micropigmentation works very well for concealing a receding hairline and balding crown.Scarring from hair transplants: SMP can help mask visibility of scarring by blending the pigment to your natural hair and skin tone.Alopecia: For patchy or diffuse hair loss from alopecia, SMP provides a uniform look by blending any bare areas or spots with your existing hair.The key is that you still have hair follicles in the treated areas, even if most of the hair has been lost. The pigment is applied directly to the scalp to mimic hair follicles, providing an appearance of shaved hair. For completely bald areas with no hair follicles, SMP may not produce natural-looking results. It is best to discuss your specific hair loss with a specialist to determine if you are a good candidate for scalp micropigmentation.Scalp micropigmentation offers a viable solution for hair loss when hair transplants are not an option or for concealing scarring from other hair restoration procedures. By choosing an experienced clinic and technician, SMP can produce very natural-looking results and help restore your confidence in your appearance.

posts.title: What's the Difference Between a Hair Patch and a Hair Wig?

faqData.question: What is the difference between a hair patch and a hair wig?
faqData.answer: A hair patch, also known as a hairpiece or toupee, is designed to cover bald spots or areas of thinning hair. It is made of human hair and meant to blend in with your natural hair to create the illusion of a full head of hair. A hair wig, on the other hand, is designed to replace a full head of hair. It covers the entire scalp and is not meant to blend in with any remaining natural hair. Wigs provide complete coverage for men with extensive hair loss or baldness.

faqData.question: How do hair patches work?
faqData.answer: Hair patches use high-quality human hair that is matched to your natural hair color and texture. The hair patch is secured to your scalp using medical-grade adhesives and/or clips to ensure a natural look. Hair patches require maintenance to ensure secure attachment and natural appearance. They need to be removed, cleaned, and reapplied every few weeks with the assistance of a hair replacement specialist.

faqData.question: Who benefits from hair replacement systems?
faqData.answer: Non-surgical hair replacement systems like hair patches and wigs benefit men who want to cover visible hair loss without undergoing hair transplant surgery. They are ideal for covering bald spots, receding hairlines, and diffuse thinning hair. Hair replacement systems can provide men with a natural-looking full head of hair, allowing them to regain lost confidence and self-esteem due to hair loss.

faqData.question: Are hair replacement systems noticeable?
faqData.answer: High-quality hair replacement systems made of human hair and properly matched to your natural hair should be virtually undetectable. When applied by an experienced hair replacement specialist, hair patches and wigs adhere securely to the scalp and blend in seamlessly with surrounding hair. However, lower quality synthetic hair pieces may appear obviously fake and are more prone to shifting or detachment, revealing their presence. For the most natural results, human hair replacement systems applied by a specialist are recommended.

posts.title: How Can You Select the Best Hair Patch for Your Needs?

faqData.question: How is a hair system installed?
faqData.answer: Hair systems are installed using medical-grade adhesives that bond the system to your natural hair and scalp. The installation process takes about an hour and is done by a trained stylist. They clean and prepare your scalp, position the hair system, and apply bonding adhesive to secure it in place. Properly installed systems can remain securely adhered for 4 to 6 weeks before needing reattachment. Some men prefer to have their systems removed and reinstalled more frequently for increased security and to allow the scalp to breathe.

faqData.question: How long do hair systems last?
faqData.answer: The lifespan of a hair system depends on several factors, including the quality of the hair used and how well you care for the system. On average, a human hair system may last 6 to 12 months with proper maintenance before needing replacement. With frequent use and handling, all systems will gradually show signs of wear over time. It is best to replace your system before damage becomes noticeable to maintain the most natural appearance.
